tags.clue: You can play on the swings here.
You study and meet your friends here.
You sleep here. Mom and Dad are here.
You can see elephants and zebras here.

blocks.title: 🔊 Meet the Places!
blocks.hint: Tap a card to hear it and see the Japanese word.

blocks.title: 💬 Let's Go!
blocks.hint: Choose a place. Then grow your sentence, one step at a time.

blocks.title: ❓ Do You Want To Go…?
blocks.hint: Tap 🔊 to hear the question and the answers, then say them out loud.
lines: Do you want to go to the park?
Yes, I do. Let's go to the park.
Do you want to go to the zoo?
Do you want to go to school?
Do you want to go home?

blocks.title: 👂 Listen & Pop!
blocks.hint: Listen, then tap the place you heard.

blocks.title: 🧩 Build the Sentence
blocks.hint: Careful: to the park, to school, home! Tap the words in order.

blocks.title: 🧭 Plan Our Day
blocks.hint: One asks, one plans, one answers. Then swap!

blocks.title: 🗂️ Which Pattern?
blocks.hint: Some places need "to the", some need "to", and one needs nothing! Tap a place, then its pattern.

blocks.title: 🕵️ Clue Detective
blocks.hint: Read the clue. Which place is it? Tap it, then say "Let's go…"

blocks.title: 🎤 Talk Time
blocks.hint: Ask, then answer in a full sentence. Swap roles each time.
lines: Where do you want to go today?
What do you do at the park?
Do you go to school every day?

blocks.title: 🎉 Great job!
blocks.message: Great job! Now you can say where to go!
